name: weekly-media-ingestion
description: Skeleton config for weekly draft-first ingestion of The Table YouTube videos and podcast episodes, scoped to the-good-book only.

seriesScope.title: The Good Book: Fresh Insights Into an Ancient Text
seriesScope.seriesLink: [The Good Book: Fresh Insights Into an Ancient Text](../series/the-good-book.md)

youtubeDiscovery.sourceUrl: TODO: supply via YOUTUBE_SOURCE_URL before this wrapper produces real output. See decision D3.
youtubeDiscovery.notes: Regex exclude patterns are evaluated case-insensitively. YouTube source URL (channel or playlist) must be supplied via YOUTUBE_SOURCE_URL before this wrapper produces real output. See decision D3.

sources.label: The Table YouTube channel or playlist
sources.notes: Seeded from the live site YouTube channel link plus the standard uploads playlist for this channel. The ingestion script uses the channel uploads RSS feed in this environment because yt-dlp is not installed, and historical backfill falls back to the scoped repo transcript archive because the live uploads RSS feed is too shallow. Verify channel-vs-streams scope before enabling writes.

sources.label: Podcast RSS feed
sources.notes: Canonical RSS feed confirmed from homepage links, llms.txt, and Apple Podcasts lookup.
